verdict.rationale: ScrapingBee's Usage API reports real-time concurrency usage for the account, which implies the API accepts concurrent requests under some account-level concurrency allowance. The official CLI also offers crawling for gathering data at scale. The evidence never documents concurrency limits, how many parallel sessions are allowed, or behavior under load. missing for 10: documented concurrency limits per plan, guidance on running many parallel requests/sessions, throttling/rate-limit behavior, independent or hands-on corroboration of performance at scale.

support.subject: As a data-engineer, I can spin up many concurrent scraping sessions to gather data at scale

citations.quote: Read real-time credit and concurrency usage for the authenticated ScrapingBee account.
Quick same-domain crawl, sitemap crawl, or Scrapy-project spider.
